nodes.speaker: mara
nodes.text: I've noticed you've been having really bad weather lately. I've been trying to help with the storm repairs, but it's not like I can do it myself. It's getting hard for me to fix everything on my own. Can we talk about it?

nodes.speaker: owen
nodes.text: You were supposed to be here last night, you never leave until you're sure.

nodes.speaker: jules
nodes.text: Hey Owen, have you heard about the latest weather forecast? I think it's really interesting, I've been wanting to share some thoughts with someone. And guess what? I know who might be interested - I just met with a friend at the café the other day. They seemed pretty fascinated by the changes in the atmospheric pressure. It made me think about the relationship between weather and our emotions. I don't know if you're into it, but I wanted to bounce some ideas off you. Have you noticed anything similar?

nodes.speaker: sarah
nodes.text: I've been feeling really alone in this conversation
